column4: Pre-Construction & Layout • Perform site consultation to confirm structure locations and identify underground utilities. Site Preparation • Cut the existing topsoil and stockpile in the designated area. • Excavate and Level the site for five (5) building sites. • Import, place, and mechanically compact fill material as required to achieve design subgrade and elevations. • Compact the site to 95% compaction to insure the building rests on a solid base. • Excavate and grade (2) 6" berms behind units 3,4, and 5, to divert surface water. Reapply existing topsoil, with seed stabilizer. (Install an orange construction fence around the berms to keep construction equipment off) • Apply straw mulch to all disturbed areas as needed for temporary stabilization during the construction phase. • Soil compaction test for each (5) building sites.

column4: Erosion Controls:  • Install silt fence, silt tubing, and matting for erosion and sediment control.    • Install 20' x 100' construction entrance. Install Geotextile fabric and 8" depth of ballast stone. Existing House Demolition:  Demolish and remove the existing residence, including the foundation. All debris will be hauled off site and properly disposed.    Existing Garage Demolition:  Demolish and remove the existing garage structure and foundation. All debris will be hauled off site and properly disposed.    Shed and Treehouse Removal:  Demolish and remove the existing shed and treehouse. All debris will be hauled off site and properly disposed.    Concrete Removal:  Demolish and remove the existing concrete walkway, driveway, and patio. Concrete will be broken up and reused on site as fill where feasible; any excess material will be hauled off site and properly disposed.    Asphalt Driveway Removal:  Demolish and remove the existing asphalt driveway. All asphalt material will be hauled off site and properly disposed.    Tree Removal:  Remove and dispose of 12 trees on the property.

column4: Utility Installation – Street to House Stub-In - approximately 1300 linear feet of trenching:    Sanitary Sewer: Excavate trench approximately 3' deep. Install a sewer pipe from the street, one to each house. Backfill trench with suitable existing dirt.    Water Service: Excavate trench approximately 3' deep. Install a pipe for water service from the street, one to each house. Backfill trench with suitable existing dirt.     Electrical and Communications Conduit: Excavate trench approximately 3' deep. Install 4" conduit from the street, one to each house for electrical service. Backfill trench with 12" of stone dust, install red tracer tape 12" above the line. Install conduit in the same trench for the communications line. Backfill the remainder of the trench with stone dust. (Electrical wiring, communications wiring, and street hookup by others.)    Gas Line Trench: Excavate trench approximately 3' wide x 3' deep for future gas service. (Gas line installation and connections by others.) Backfill trench with stone dust, install yellow tracer tape 12" above the line.    Install approximately 125' lineal feet of 18" RCP, with a precast concrete headwall at each end. Install outlet protection.     All work to be performed in accordance with approved plans, local codes, and utility company requirements. Layout and coordination with utility providers to be confirmed prior to installation.
